title: Benchmarking Stochastic Approximation Algorithms for Fairness-Constrained Training of Deep Neural Networks
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The benchmark measures the performance of optimization algorithms for training deep neural networks with fairness constraints, specifically focusing on mitigating bias related to the protected attribute of race in an income prediction task.
models_tested: The paper does not evaluate Large Language Models. It trains a Deep Neural Network (DNN) with 2 hidden layers from scratch using various optimization algorithms (Stochastic Ghost, SSL-ALM, ALM, SSw, SGD).
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion, as its focus is on algorithmic fairness with respect to race.
